arms.label: Independent marginals
arms.about: Samples every column on its own, so it has no dependence between columns. It is the floor every real generator has to beat.

arms.label: Gaussian copula
arms.about: A statistical baseline that keeps each column's distribution and adds correlation between columns (Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage).

arms.label: Gaussian copula, shrink 0.25
arms.about: The same copula with less shrinkage, so it keeps more of the real correlations. This is the config Track 1 carried into Phase 3.

arms.label: Gaussian copula, shrink 0.10
arms.about: The copula Track 1 picked after tuning: the least shrinkage tested, and the best correlation of any generator.

arms.label: CTGAN
arms.about: A GAN for tables, trained for 300 epochs. At 94 training rows it learns almost nothing beyond the floor.

arms.label: CTGAN, small networks
arms.about: CTGAN with smaller networks, Track 1's tuned setting. Its columns look more real, and it still learns no dependence.

arms.label: TVAE
arms.about: A variational autoencoder for tables, trained for 300 epochs. It memorizes training rows, which makes it a positive control for the privacy attacks.

arms.label: Tabular diffusion
arms.about: A diffusion model for tables, trained for 3000 steps. It has the best fidelity of the neural generators and copies most of its training rows.

arms.label: Tabular diffusion, regularized
arms.about: The diffusion model trained for 1000 steps with dropout, the only setting that passed Track 1's memorization check.
